title: PP/TP throughput heatmap + regression detector for multi-GPU inference
creator: Anika Rao
description: Create a repeatable benchmark and anomaly detector that maps steady-state tokens/sec and p95 latency across combined tensor-parallel (TP) and pipeline-parallel (PP) configurations. Produce heatmaps that encode throughput, p95, and cold->warm warmup delta to help pinpoint fragility in cross-node pipelines and feed a lightweight CI regression check for nightly runs.
acceptance_criteria: Heatmap generator produces PNG/CSV outputs for tokens/sec and p95 across TP x PP grid for given model+seqlen+batch combos
Automated regression detector ingests the last N nightly runs and flags >10% tokens/sec drop or >20% p95 increase for any cell, with a false-positive rate under ~5% based on historical runs
Benchmark harness supports toggles: KV cache on/off, key-value prefix length sweep, sequence-length distribution profiles, and request arrival patterns (steady vs microburst)
Results are surfaced in the Console perf dashboard with links to raw artifacts and associated GitHub PRs/Run IDs
CI job exits non-zero when regression detector signals a confirmed regression and posts a reproducible reproducer config in the ticket
plan: Design grid: TP variants [1,2,4,8], PP stages [1,2,4] with constrained node budget (max 8 GPUs)
Implement harness extension to orchestrate mixed TP/PP using existing multi-node test runner with optional KV cache warmups
Instrument metrics: tokens/sec (steady-state, 60s window), p95 latency, p50, variance, and warmup slope (first 30s vs steady-state)
Build heatmap exporter (CSV + PNG) and minimal aggregator that keeps the last 10 nightly runs
Implement regression detector with configurable thresholds and a lightweight statistical check (percent-change + median absolute deviation safeguard)
Add Console dashboard wiring and CI step to post artifacts and signal failures
steps_to_reproduce: Run sample job locally: ./bench/run_grid.sh --model llama-13b --seq 1024 --batch 2 --tp 2 --pp 2 --kv-cache on
View generated artifacts under /artifacts/eng-97831/<run_id>/heatmap-*.png and heatmap-*.csv
Trigger CI nightly job: .github/workflows/nightly-bench.yml includes step `bench:run-grid` that persists to S3 and triggers detector
results_summary: PoC runs on dev cluster (3/1/2026) show expected degradation as TP increases with small PP stages up to 4 stages. Heatmaps make hotspots visible: e.g., TP=8, PP=1 exhibits 18% lower tokens/sec vs TP=4,PP=2 for same GPU count indicating kernel scheduling inefficiency. Initial regression detector tuned to flag >12% throughput drop and >25% p95 increase; this generated one alert for a driver-induced variance during driver 545.12 -> 545.25 rollout.
blockers: Intermittent network packet drops on cluster-c causing noisy p95 outliers; infra team investigating
Need a signed access policy for nightly bucket write from CI runner (security review queued)
